verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents payroll journal entries being posted or synced automatically to an accounting ledger such as QuickBooks or Xero. The closest items are adjacent: timesheet and schedule data that "syncs to QuickBooks", manual payroll report export for an accountant, and Workforce API webhooks and GraphQL that a developer could use to build such a sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
